description: As reviewed by Swift, Fisher and Van de Walle, dynamic light scattering on simulated body fluids found free-floating calcium phosphate clusters of about 1 nm, suggested to be Posner clusters, and cryogenic electron microscopy in 2010 imaged nanometer clusters coalescing near a seed crystal.
limitations: Simulated body fluid, not neural tissue. Whether Posners form in real body fluid is not established.

sources.quote: identified evidence for freefloating calcium phosphate clusters of size roughly 1 nm
